title: HVAC Preventive Maintenance Service Request Form
subtitle: Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance: defines need, constraints, and assignment.
description: HVAC Preventive Maintenance Service Request Form covers air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone. The facility maintenance coordinator records Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance need, timing, access, and assignment. HVAC Preventive Maintenance Service Request Form keeps Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance exceptions visible until the facility maintenance coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use HVAC Preventive Maintenance Service Request Form at equipment room, roof, mechanical area, and occupied zone. Document air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone identity before Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance begins. Compare air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone findings with stated Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance criteria; route unresolved Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance issues to qualified HVAC service supervisor. For HVAC Preventive Maintenance Service Request Form, confirm requirements for Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance. Ask qualified HVAC service supervisor to review Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance conditions beyond the facility maintenance coordinator's role.

sections.title: Requested-service contact and source record
sections.guidance: For Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance, identify responsible parties, equipment room, roof, mechanical area, and occupied zone, and the linked air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone source.

sections.title: Requested scope and practical constraints
sections.guidance: Capture Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance facts for air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.title: Request constraints, assignment, and response
sections.guidance: Resolve open Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance request questions; have facility maintenance coordinator record the assignment, response owner, and requester follow-up while keeping the record strictly at the intake and routing stage.

blocks.label: Scheduling constraints, holds, and supplied evidence
items: Refrigerant or combustion concern outside authorization
Blocked drainage or active water damage
Required capacity, alarm, or sequence not restored
Prior or requester-supplied: nameplate and asset-tag photograph
Prior or requester-supplied: before-and-after readings tied to instruments
Prior or requester-supplied: replaced-part and consumable record
Prior or requester-supplied: operating-test result by served zone
blocks.guidance: Do not assign or authorize the Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance request when energy isolation, refrigerant concern, combustion concern, or failed operating safeguard remains unresolved. Retain information supplied with the request and route unresolved constraints to facility maintenance coordinator.
